name: MonarchAiGhostText
title: AiGhostText
summary: A text field with inline completion: the model's suggested continuation is drawn in the muted text color after the typed text and accepted by a tap on it, an Accept suggestion button, a TalkBack action or Tab on a hardware keyboard. MonarchAiCompletion is the state behind it.
whenToUse: Where an assistant can finish what the person is writing: a reply, a description, a commit message.
whenNotToUse: For a list of completions to choose from use a menu or suggestion chips. For rewriting text the person selected use an assistant action, not inline completion.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiGhostText(state: TextFieldState, completion: MonarchAiCompletion, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, showAcceptButton: Boolean = true, lineLimits: TextFieldLineLimits = TextFieldLineLimits.MultiLine(), labels: MonarchAiGhostTextLabels = MonarchAiGhostTextLabels(), onAccept: ((MonarchAiCompletionAcceptance, MonarchAiGhostTextAcceptKind) -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchAiGhostText(state: TextFieldState, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, completionEnabled: Boolean = true, debounceMillis: Long = MonarchAiCompletion.DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MILLIS, minimumCharacters: Int = MonarchAiCompletion.DEFAULT_MINIMUM_CHARACTERS, showAcceptButton: Boolean = true, lineLimits: TextFieldLineLimits = TextFieldLineLimits.MultiLine(), labels: MonarchAiGhostTextLabels = MonarchAiGhostTextLabels(), onAccept: ((MonarchAiCompletionAcceptance, MonarchAiGhostTextAcceptKind) -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, complete: suspend (text: String, cursor: Int) -> String?)
@Stable class MonarchAiCompletion(scope: CoroutineScope, debounceMillis: Long = 300L, minimumCharacters: Int = 3, enabled: Boolean = true, complete: suspend (text: String, cursor: Int) -> String?)
MonarchAiCompletion: val status: MonarchAiCompletionStatus; val suggestion: String; val text: String; val cursor: Int; var enabled: Boolean; var onError: ((Throwable) -> Unit)?

MonarchAiCompletion: fun update(text: String, cursor: Int); fun dismiss(); fun accept(): MonarchAiCompletionAcceptance?; fun acceptWord(): MonarchAiCompletionAcceptance?; fun setComposing(composing: Boolean); companion fun nextWord(suggestion: String): String

@Composable fun rememberMonarchAiCompletion(debounceMillis: Long = MonarchAiCompletion.DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MILLIS, minimumCharacters: Int = MonarchAiCompletion.DEFAULT_MINIMUM_CHARACTERS, enabled: Boolean = true, complete: suspend (text: String, cursor: Int) -> String?): MonarchAiCompletion
enum class MonarchAiCompletionStatus { Idle, Waiting, Loading, Ready, Error }
data class MonarchAiCompletionAcceptance(inserted: String, text: String, cursor: Int)
class MonarchAiGhostTextLabels(announce: ((String) -> String)? = null, accept: String? = null, dismiss: String? = null, accepted: String? = null, dismissed: String? = null)

options.name: state
options.description: The text of the field. The suggestion is never written into it until accepted.

options.name: completion
options.description: Completion state you keep, from rememberMonarchAiCompletion, to read or drive it. Replaces complete, debounceMillis, minimumCharacters and completionEnabled.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, also the TalkBack label.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: An example shown while the field is empty and focused.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field can be edited. A disabled field shows no suggestion.

options.name: completionEnabled
options.description: Turns suggestions off when false (second overload).

options.name: debounceMillis
options.description: How long typing must pause before a request is sent (second overload).

options.name: minimumCharacters
options.description: The fewest characters before the cursor, without surrounding white space, for a request (second overload).

options.name: showAcceptButton
options.description: Shows the Accept suggestion button under the field while a suggestion shows. Its 48dp room is always kept.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the announcements and action names.

options.name: onAccept
options.description: Called after a suggestion, or one word of it, went into the text.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Called when the user dismissed the suggestion.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus and press interactions of the field.

options.name: complete
options.description: Asks the model for a continuation of the text at the cursor, a UTF-16 offset. Return the text to insert, or null for none. It is cancelled when its answer is stale.

states.name: idle
states.description: Only the typed text, or the placeholder while the field is empty.

states.name: waiting, loading
states.description: Nothing extra is drawn while the request waits for the pause or is in flight.

states.name: ready
states.description: The suggestion is drawn after the typed text in the muted text color, and the Accept suggestion button appears in the room kept for it.

states.name: error
states.description: Nothing is drawn. onError of the completion is called.

states.name: focused
states.description: The field's border takes the focus ring color. Suggestions are only made while the field has focus.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled text and fill colors, no editing and no suggestion.

appearance: The field uses the Monarch text field colors of MonarchTextField; the suggestion uses the muted text color and the accept button is a small ghost MonarchButton, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web wraps any textarea or input; on Android the component is the field, because the suggestion must be drawn by the field's OutputTransformation. Because of that the field takes a TextFieldState instead of a value and callback, the Compose text API that supports output transformations. On iOS the system's inline predictions are turned off; on Android the suggestion is never shown while the keyboard is composing a word, so it does not compete with the keyboard's suggestion strip, and the keyboard's predictions are left on. Android has no accessibility hint, so iOS's instruction label is not offered: the announcement of a new suggestion says how to accept it, and TalkBack has Accept suggestion and Dismiss suggestion actions. The keys are the web's: Tab or the forward arrow accepts, Ctrl or Alt with the forward arrow accepts a word, Escape dismisses; they need a hardware keyboard. The cursor is a UTF-16 offset, as on the web. Accepting edits the TextFieldState, so it is one step in its undo history. The tap area on the suggestion is computed from the default Material 3 content padding of the field. The web's useAiRewrite and applyAiRewrite are not part of this entry.
accessibility: The field is a Material 3 text field labelled by label; TalkBack reads the typed text only, never the suggestion.
A new suggestion is announced through a polite live region under the field, with how to accept it; the rest of one being typed through or taken word by word is not announced again.
"Suggestion accepted." and "Suggestion dismissed." are announced through the same live region.
While a suggestion shows, the field has the TalkBack actions "Accept suggestion" and "Dismiss suggestion".
The Accept suggestion button has a 48dp touch target; the tap area on the suggestion itself is its text with a 4dp margin, which is smaller, so the button is the full-size alternative.
The suggestion differs from typed text by its position after the caret as well as its color.
edgeCases: A suggestion is only shown with the caret at the end of the text (white space may follow), never in the middle or with a selection.
Losing focus, disabling the field, a selection or the keyboard composing a word dismisses the suggestion.
A change to the text from the app is treated like typing: a new request is made after the pause.
A request whose text has since changed is cancelled and its answer ignored.

The tap on the suggestion, the hardware keys and the alignment of the suggestion with the caret were tested under Robolectric only; a device check with TalkBack and a hardware keyboard is still needed.

examples.title: Reply with suggestions
examples.template:
MonarchAiGhostText(
    state = state,
    modifier = Modifier.focusRequester(focus),
    label = {{label}},
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
) { text, _ ->
    if (text.endsWith({{text}})) {{suggestion}} else null
}
examples.code:
MonarchAiGhostText(
    state = state,
    modifier = Modifier.focusRequester(focus),
    label = "Reply",
    placeholder = "Type “Thanks” or “Let me know” and pause",
) { text, _ ->
    if (text.endsWith("Thanks")) " for getting back to me so quickly." else null
}

examples.title: Completion state you keep
examples.setup:
val state = rememberTextFieldState("Thanks for")
val completion = rememberMonarchAiCompletion(debounceMillis = 500L) { _, _ -> " the update." }
examples.code:
MonarchAiGhostText(
    state = state,
    completion = completion,
    label = "Reply",
    helperText = "Status: ${completion.status}",
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web chip names the Tab key of a hardware keyboard. A touch keyboard has no Tab key, so Android accepts a suggestion by a tap on the suggestion text, by the "Accept suggestion" button or the TalkBack action; with a hardware keyboard Tab accepts as on the web, but the chip is not drawn.
parityExceptions.convention: touch keyboards have no Tab key (Material text-field completion is accepted by tap)
